method: Queries and exact supporting source spans fixed before any rankings; author has seen reviewed cases, so this is a development diagnostic, not a blind holdout. Empty required_quotes means no answer established by supplied source; inspect returned results for irrelevance rather than count textual overlap as an answer.

questions.query: Why does the applicant need name change documents for ID?
required_quotes: The applicant generally will need the name change documentation to change the name on her/his ID.

questions.query: What is the goal for photographs of infants?
required_quotes: The goal is the best likeness that can reasonably be obtained:

questions.query: Why might a recently issued certificate contain an older photograph?
required_quotes: Be aware that even if the certificate itself was recently issued, because of U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services processing times, the photograph may not have been taken within six months of submitting the application.

questions.query: Why does the passport name matter for identity?
required_quotes: The applicant's name is an integral part of her/his identity.

questions.query: When can an applicant continue using a previous name?
required_quotes: unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name

questions.query: When may a limited-validity passport be issued for emergency travel?
required_quotes: more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID
If there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel

questions.query: Can a passport photo show a different hairstyle or facial hair?
required_quotes: acceptable if it still is a good likeness of the applicant

questions.query: How recent should the passport photograph be?
required_quotes: The photograph should be taken within six months of submitting the application

questions.query: Must every applicant with a name change submit ID in the new name?
required_quotes: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11 do not need to submit ID in the new name.

questions.query: Are black and white passport photographs acceptable?
required_quotes: The photograph must be in color
